# ActaRoot, Inc.

> ActaRoot, Inc. — the company behind OHWUT.

## Official pages
- [ActaRoot, Inc. | Company Behind OHWUT](https://actaroot.com/): ActaRoot, Inc. is the U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu and the company behind OHWUT, an online shopping platform.
- [About ActaRoot | Company Profile](https://actaroot.com/about/): Learn about ActaRoot, Inc., its U.S. corporate identity, founder Min Sihu and the OHWUT brand.
- [OHWUT | The ActaRoot Shopping Brand](https://actaroot.com/brands/): Explore OHWUT, an online shopping brand under ActaRoot combining conventional retail and participation-based price reductions.
- [Min Sihu | Founder of ActaRoot and OHWUT](https://actaroot.com/founder/): Min Sihu (Sihu Min, 민시후) founded ActaRoot, Inc. and OHWUT. Find his official personal profile and projects.
- [ActaRoot FAQ | Company, Founder and OHWUT](https://actaroot.com/faq/): Answers to questions about ActaRoot, Inc., Min Sihu, OHWUT and their official domains.
